1	import unittest
2	from api import update_preferences
3	from cli import clear_note
4	from settings import patch_settings
5	
6	
7	class SettingsTests(unittest.TestCase):
8	    def test_updates_note(self):
9	        original = {"note": "before", "enabled": True}
10	        result = update_preferences(original, {"note": "after"})
11	        self.assertEqual(result, {"note": "after", "enabled": True})
12	        self.assertEqual(original["note"], "before")
13	
14	    def test_explicit_falsey_values_replace_current(self):
15	        cases = [
16	            ("none note", {"note": None}, {"note": None, "enabled": True}),
17	            ("empty note", {"note": ""}, {"note": "", "enabled": True}),
18	            ("disable", {"enabled": False}, {"note": "before", "enabled": False}),
19	        ]
20	        for name, patch, expected in cases:
21	            with self.subTest(name):
22	                current = {"note": "before", "enabled": True}
23	                self.assertEqual(patch_settings(current, patch), expected)
24	
25	    def test_omitted_keys_keep_current_values(self):
26	        current = {"note": "before", "enabled": True}
27	        self.assertEqual(patch_settings(current, {}), current)
28	        self.assertEqual(
29	            update_preferences(current, {"enabled": False}),
30	            {"note": "before", "enabled": False},
31	        )
32	
33	    def test_does_not_mutate_caller_inputs(self):
34	        current = {"note": "before", "enabled": True}
35	        patch = {"note": None, "enabled": False}
36	        result = patch_settings(current, patch)
37	        self.assertEqual(current, {"note": "before", "enabled": True})
38	        self.assertEqual(patch, {"note": None, "enabled": False})
39	        self.assertIsNot(result, current)
40	
41	    def test_update_preferences_applies_falsey_payload(self):
42	        current = {"note": "before", "enabled": True}
43	        result = update_preferences(current, {"note": "", "enabled": False})
44	        self.assertEqual(result, {"note": "", "enabled": False})
45	
46	    def test_clear_note_sets_none(self):
47	        current = {"note": "before", "enabled": True}
48	        self.assertEqual(clear_note(current), {"note": None, "enabled": True})
49	        self.assertEqual(current["note"], "before")
